meta.title: Brand Identity — Yours, Entirely
meta.subtitle: A bespoke wedding-site service built for Instagram discovery

strategy.product: A bespoke wedding-site service with RSVP, fee-free Pix gift lists, and an admin panel for couples.
strategy.audience: Design-conscious engaged couples in Curitiba and the surrounding region, initially, who are 4–14 months from their wedding and are choosing suppliers who can make the occasion feel personal.
strategy.trigger: They need invitations, RSVP, guest information, or a gift list and discover that generic wedding-site templates do not reflect their celebration or that platforms take a percentage from gifts.
strategy.problem: Couples must choose between a generic-looking wedding site and an experience that reduces the money received from their guests; neither feels worthy of a carefully planned celebration.
strategy.alternatives: Template platforms, a manually assembled link page, an invitation without RSVP management, or doing without a wedding site.
strategy.distinctive_value: Each site is shaped around the couple’s story while their guests can RSVP and send Pix gifts directly, with no payment gateway fee deducted from the gift.
proof_points: The reusable product includes a working RSVP database, Pix BR Code generation, an administrative panel, and gift-list management.
A real Marcus & Daíse wedding site is authorised for use as the first public case.
A first paid project at R$500 validates an entry price, not yet the final pricing ceiling.
strategy.positioning: For design-conscious engaged couples preparing a wedding, casamentos.app is the bespoke wedding-site service that gives their celebration a personal online home and preserves 100% of Pix gift value, because each site is built around the couple and includes RSVP, direct Pix gifts, and simple self-management—unlike generic template platforms or a patchwork of links.
strategy.salient_idea: A wedding site that belongs to the couple.
strategy.promise: Your celebration online, unmistakably yours—and your gifts remain entirely yours.
evidence_notes: Fact: the project materials document RSVP, Pix gifts without a gateway fee, and an administrative panel.
Fact: the launch plan identifies Instagram as an owned acquisition channel and the first public case as the strongest marketing asset.
Founder decision: casamentos.app is the public-facing name; BG Casamentos is legacy/internal language.
Recommendation: use product proof in the Instagram feed, not just wedding photography or decoration.

territories.name: Yours, Entirely
territories.thesis: Make ownership the visible and verbal centre of the brand: the couple’s story, style, guest experience, and gifts are all theirs.
territories.audience_response: This feels personal enough for our wedding and practical enough to trust with guests and gifts.
territories.metaphor: A custom frame or window: each composition holds a different couple, screen, or detail because no celebration repeats.
tagline_alternates: Your story. Your site. Your gifts.
Made for your celebration, not a template.
territories.voice_sample: Your guests are here for your story. Your site should be, too.
territories.symbol: A soft-cornered, asymmetrical frame that crops photography, interface previews, and colour fields; it signals a site made to fit the couple rather than a fixed template.

typography.display: Cormorant Garamond, with a high-contrast editorial rhythm for names, intimate statements, and campaign lines.
typography.body: Inter for interface proof, captions, and clear service information.

territories.application: An Instagram carousel opens with ‘Your story. Your site. Your gifts.’, then moves through one real couple’s homepage, RSVP flow, and a direct Pix gift screen within changing custom frames.
territories.risk: Without visible product proof, the territory can look like a wedding editorial rather than a service with concrete utility.

territories.name: The First Page
territories.thesis: Position the wedding site as the opening page of the celebration—the place where anticipation begins before the day arrives.
territories.audience_response: This makes the digital part of our wedding feel as considered as the invitation and event itself.
territories.metaphor: A sequence of pages and timestamps that turns preparations into a story unfolding toward the day.
tagline_alternates: Before the day, there is your story.
The first page of your celebration.
territories.voice_sample: Before the first toast, give your guests a place to arrive.
territories.symbol: A page edge and date marker that repeat as an unfolding sequence across posts, stories, and the site.

typography.display: A high-contrast editorial serif with generous line spacing.
typography.body: A calm grotesk for explanatory and product information.

territories.application: A reel moves from a printed invitation-like opening frame to the wedding homepage, RSVP, and a final date card.
territories.risk: The emotional narrative may obscure the fee-free Pix benefit if it is not deliberately repeated in product posts.

territories.name: Beautifully in Order
territories.thesis: Turn the busy coordination of a wedding into calm, elegant control without sounding like event-management software.
territories.audience_response: This will make the practical parts feel easier while keeping the wedding beautiful.
territories.metaphor: An organised invitation grid: many essential details, each given a clear, graceful place.
tagline_alternates: RSVP, gifts, and your story—in place.
territories.voice_sample: The details are handled. You can get back to the celebration.
territories.symbol: A flexible grid with one intentionally offset cell, representing a personal celebration held by an orderly system.

typography.display: An elegant serif used with restraint for wedding character.
typography.body: A precise sans-serif used for service clarity and interface callouts.

territories.application: A carousel shows a compact RSVP dashboard, guest confirmation flow, and direct Pix gift list with one detail per structured card.
territories.risk: Overusing interface imagery risks making casamentos.app feel like a generic planning tool.

recommendation.reason: It connects the emotional decision—wanting a wedding site with the couple’s real identity—to the commercial decision—keeping gifts entirely theirs—without pretending the service is a platform.
recommendation.tradeoff: It gives up the immediate operational clarity of Beautifully in Order, so the Instagram system must repeatedly show real RSVP and Pix details.

brand_system.one_liner: Bespoke wedding sites with RSVP and fee-free Pix gifts.
brand_system.value_proposition: A wedding site made around your story, with the details guests need and Pix gifts that arrive in full.
brand_system.logo_concept: A custom, soft-cornered frame that can enclose the wordmark, crop a photograph, or reveal a website screen. The mark should be drawn as a simple SVG after design review; this report defines the logic, not a finished trademark.

palette.name: Plum
palette.role: Primary brand colour, headline backgrounds, primary buttons; use Ivory text.

palette.name: Rose Clay
palette.role: Secondary colour for soft framing and cropped shapes; decorative with dark text only after layout contrast review.

palette.name: Antique Gold
palette.role: Accent, icon, and keyline—not normal-size body text on Ivory.

palette.name: Cocoa
palette.role: Body text, monochrome logo, and high-contrast detail.

typography.display: Cormorant Garamond, 500–600. Use in short, elegant, sentence-case display lines and couple names; tight tracking only at large sizes.
typography.body: Inter, 400–600. Use for all product facts, captions, calls to action, and interface content. Fall back to ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif.
typography.behaviour: Make the contrast deliberate: expressive display type earns attention; concise sans-serif earns trust. Do not set explanatory paragraphs in the serif.

voice_traits.meaning: Write with genuine care and specific wedding context without resorting to generic romance language.
voice_traits.do: Your guests can arrive already knowing where to be, what to bring, and how to celebrate with you.
voice_traits.dont: Make your fairy-tale wedding dreams come true.

voice_traits.meaning: State the practical benefit plainly, especially when discussing Pix, RSVP, timing, and pricing.
voice_traits.do: Guests gift by Pix. The full amount goes to you.
voice_traits.dont: Unlock a seamless, next-generation gifting solution.

voice_traits.meaning: Put the couple’s choices and story in the foreground; the brand stays as the thoughtful maker.
voice_traits.do: Marcus and Daíse chose marsala, a countdown, and a gift list that feels like theirs.
voice_traits.dont: Our premium aesthetic transforms every love story.

message_pillars.title: A site with your signature
message_pillars.message: Colours, words, photos, and details begin with the couple—not a fixed catalogue of layouts.
message_pillars.proof: Show a real before-and-after creative brief or two visibly different case sites.

message_pillars.title: Gifts arrive in full
message_pillars.message: Guests can send gifts through direct Pix, without a gateway fee deducted from the amount.
message_pillars.proof: Show the direct Pix gift flow and explain the mechanism in one short caption; verify all payment wording before publication.

message_pillars.title: The details stay easy
message_pillars.message: RSVP, gifts, and guest information live in one place that the couple can manage without technical help.
message_pillars.proof: Show real RSVP and admin-panel screens with private data removed.

brand_system.image_direction: Use real couples, real venues, tactile invitation materials, and actual site screens. Crop closely; favour warm daylight, candlelit shadows, and rich material texture. Use the frame motif to connect photographs and product UI. Avoid stock couples, hands holding rings, champagne cheers, generic flower flat-lays, and oversized scripted text placed over faces.
layout_principles: Let one meaningful photograph, a site screen, or a sentence lead each composition—never all three at once.
Use the soft-corner frame as a recurring crop, not a container around every item.
Pair a large serif statement with a compact sans-serif fact such as ‘RSVP + direct Pix’.
Keep Instagram carousels high-contrast and readable at a glance: Plum or Cocoa text on Ivory; Ivory text on Plum.
Use antique gold for lines and small moments only; it is not a body-text colour.

applications.name: Instagram profile and pinned posts
applications.headline: A wedding site that is entirely yours.
applications.direction: Bio: ‘Bespoke wedding sites · RSVP + fee-free Pix gifts · Curitiba + Brazil’. Pin: the real case, how direct Pix works, and the process from conversation to launch. Use a Plum avatar with the custom-frame mark at 32px.

applications.name: Instagram case-study carousel
applications.headline: Their story. Their site. Their gifts.
applications.direction: Slide 1 carries the claim in a full Plum frame. Slides 2–5 show a real homepage, RSVP, gift-list detail, and one client-specific design choice. Last slide: ‘See your celebration online’ with WhatsApp CTA.

applications.name: Instagram Reel cover and sequence
applications.headline: Not a template. A place for your celebration.
applications.direction: Open with an invitation-like name card, then move through a five-second screen sequence: hero, details, RSVP, Pix gift. End with the frame mark and CTA; use captions for every factual benefit.

applications.name: Landing-page hero
applications.headline: Your wedding site, made around you. Your gifts, received in full.
applications.direction: Hero shows one real couple site inside the asymmetric frame. The supporting line names RSVP and direct Pix; the primary CTA opens WhatsApp. The page explains the service before the tagline.

applications.name: Favicon and social avatar
applications.headline: The frame, reduced.
applications.direction: Use only the simple asymmetrical frame in Plum on Ivory or Ivory on Plum. Test at 16, 24, and 32 pixels; do not attempt to render the full wordmark at favicon size.

dos: Lead with a real couple, a real site screen, or a concrete product moment.
Use casamentos.app consistently in profile name, bio, landing page, footer attribution, and public sales material.
Repeat the direct-Pix benefit with exact, plain language.
Show visibly different couple sites to prove bespoke work.
Keep all body text in Cocoa on Ivory or Ivory on Plum for reliable readability.
donts: Do not use BG Casamentos in public-facing identity once migration begins.
Do not fill the feed with generic wedding photography without a service or product point.
Do not describe the service as a platform or rely on unsupported claims about competitors.
Do not use Antique Gold or Rose Clay for small body text on Ivory.
Do not treat the proposed frame symbol as trademark-cleared or a finished production logo.

strengths: The service has functional product proof, not only a concept.
The no-fee direct Pix mechanism is concrete and easy to explain.
The first case can make bespoke work visible immediately.
assumptions: The first acquisition focus remains Instagram discovery and WhatsApp conversion.
Curitiba is the initial geographic focus, with national service possible later.
The first public case remains authorised for portfolio use.
risks: One public case may not yet prove range; make contrast across future sites visible as soon as possible.
The direct-Pix message must be worded accurately and reviewed against the actual implementation and customer terms.
casamentos.app may require a preliminary name and trademark search before substantial launch investment.
next_tests: Five-second recognition: show the pinned case-post cover to engaged couples and ask what the service does.
Audience comprehension: ask whether viewers understand both bespoke design and direct Pix after one carousel.
One-week recall: ask whether viewers remember ‘Entirely yours’, the frame, or fee-free Pix.
Monochrome test: print the frame mark in one colour and confirm it remains recognisable.
Favicon test: compare the mark at 16–32px against other wedding-service icons.
Landing-message test: test the hero against the current headline for WhatsApp click-through quality.
Competitor-confusion check: shuffle anonymised posts with wedding suppliers and confirm casamentos.app is correctly identified.
validation.legal_note: This is a strategic and creative recommendation, not trademark clearance, legal advice, or a font-license opinion. Confirm name availability, final logo clearance, and font terms before commercial launch.
